subject: maths
question: 84 persons take 56 days to complete a certain task. When one-fourth of the task was completed, one-seventh of the workers left. How many days in all does it take to complete the entire task?
solution:
**Given**

84 persons take 56 days to complete a work.

**Concept**

Man- day work

Total work = number of men × Number of days taken to complete the work

Efficiency of men = work done/number of men

**Calculation**

Total units of work = 84 × 56

⇒ 4704

one fourth of work = 4704/4

⇒ 1176&
